name: frontier-width-lab
description: Wave fifteen, lane DI: a generic interface whose own methods return the interface applied to a fresh method-level type parameter (`Foo<T>.map<U>(...): Foo<U>`), the `Array<T>`-shaped pattern that drives the frontier's width past any depth cutoff. Exercises the width cutoff (RT003) directly and fast, standing in for the `lib.dom` measurement that only a live run reproduces.
